title: Fairlands
description: Fair survival rules for multiplayer worlds
body:
Fairlands is a server-focused Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.x that adds fairer multiplayer survival rules without removing danger.

It keeps spawn worth building in, softens destructive PVP edge cases, makes death less punishing without enabling full KeepInventory, and adds a first pass at distance-based world progression.

Current features include Partial KeepInventory, death XP handling, respawn setup restrictions, spawn safe-zone protection, creeper grief prevention, player damage caps, PVP combat logging penalties, feedback commands, invisibility tab hiding, and ore progression by distance from world spawn.

Source and documentation: https://github.com/Aqu1tain/fairlands
